text: ok. so now some of them are just not driving on a road to get to their destination
resolution: Cars were cutting across terrain to reach goals because the routing passability mask was 'drivable' = any tile with a finite vehicleCost, which includes sidewalk (1.8), grass (1.9), mud (3.2), sand (2.45), median (6.0) and parking (1.4); the shortest-HOP BFS treated those as valid path cells and shortcut across them off-road. Narrowed the mask to the actual ROAD NETWORK: preferredByVehicles surfaces (lanes/road/asphalt/junction) PLUS crosswalk (the one non-preferred tile a car must cross to connect lanes to junctions — excluding it re-seals the network). Terrain is now excluded, so a baked route physically cannot leave the road. Still 14 cars routing across the city; 5/5 traffic tests; re-baked + self-shot confirms cars on-road. SHA 26f3bfe1f.
